case_studies.title: Sustainment Process Improvement
case_studies.operational_need: Engineering and sustainment teams needed faster visibility from issue identification to coordinated action.
case_studies.engineering_response: Created repeatable tracking, stakeholder alignment, and sustainment decision support using approved public process-improvement evidence.
case_studies.verified_outcome: Reduced issue-to-action time by 35% across 54 avionics systems and supported readiness-focused sustainment decisions.
case_studies.detail: The public evidence shows Pete building structure around recurring sustainment problems: centralizing visibility, aligning engineering and supply-chain stakeholders, and translating status into action. The result was a faster issue-to-action path and a process adopted as a squadron tracking requirement.

case_studies.title: Repair and Test Improvement
case_studies.operational_need: Repair and testing performance needed improvement to reduce sustainment risk and restore supportability.
case_studies.engineering_response: Coordinated depot, supply-chain, engineering, contractor, and program stakeholders to work through constraints and restore execution flow.
case_studies.verified_outcome: Improved repair and testing rates by 70%.
case_studies.detail: The public resume evidence supports a coordination-heavy engineering response rather than a single-person claim. Pete helped connect technical constraints, stakeholder action, and sustainment priorities so repair and test performance could improve.

case_studies.title: Missing-Part Reduction
case_studies.operational_need: Missing-part conditions were creating friction in sustainment execution and supportability.
case_studies.engineering_response: Used centralized tracking, engineering coordination, and supply-chain engagement to improve visibility and drive action.
case_studies.detail: The public evidence connects this result to sustainment visibility, data tracking, and cross-functional coordination. The story demonstrates how Pete uses process and systems thinking to turn recurring support issues into measurable improvement.

case_studies.title: Engineering-Services Contract Oversight
case_studies.operational_need: Engineering-services work required disciplined oversight, funding authorization, performance tracking, and compliance.
case_studies.engineering_response: Served as COR, tracked performance metrics, authorized funding, supported contract documentation, and coordinated contractor execution.
case_studies.verified_outcome: Supported oversight of more than $36M in engineering-services contract scope.
case_studies.detail: The public evidence shows contracting work that combined technical understanding with program execution discipline. Pete also created SOWs, PWSs, Market Research Reports, and supported development of a five-year engineering-services contract.
